title.narrative: Public finance for children in Cameroon has improved through evidence generation, advocacy and capacity building. Recently, a significant change in the budget allocated to social affairs, particularly in education (12.8% in 2022 compared to 14.3% in 2024), and health (3.5% in 2022 compared to 5% in 2024).
